basic_info.description: In the heart of Russian Hill, this charming duplex presents an incredible opportunity for both homeowners & investors alike. Two blocks from Polk & Union St,f ind an array of cafés, top-rated restaurants, and boutique shopping. Short drive down to Van Ness Ave seamlessly connects you to I-101. The top unit boasts 3 sizable bedrooms and a cozy living room accompanied by a fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings. A long hallway leads to 2 additional bd, a full & half bath, and a spacious kitchen w. a pass-through pantry into a formal dining room. This elegant space is complemented by its original wall cabinets, stained glass details, and second fireplace. The bottom unit features 2 spacious bedrooms and a cozy living room with its fireplace. A long hallway takes you to a large kitchen w. a pass-through pantry, leading into a formal dining room adorned with its original wall cabinetry and stained glass cabinet doors. Both units have gleaming hardwood floors, new light fixtures, and brand-new gas stoves. Additionally, each unit has separate utility rooms. Beautifully landscaped backyard ft. a fruitful lemon tree and a yard ready to be reimagined. This exceptional duplex is a rare and versatile opportunity in one of SFs most desirable neighborhoods.
